第008章 聊聊人生
力武境六阶对战力武境八阶，完胜！
越了两级挑战，岳雨虽然在没受到一丝伤害的情况下击杀了大汉，但若是大汉能再坚持一会儿，恐怕就要逃命了。因为此时他的灵气已经快归零了。没有足够的灵气值，施展不出雷芒指，那还打个毛。
“才四百经验？“跟上次击杀嗜灵兽给的经验一比，岳雨不免觉得有些少，想着自己杀死的是虚无境三阶灵兽，而大汉也只是力武境八阶，便觉的四百经验已经不错了。
看着地上大汉的尸体，岳雨暗自叹息了一声，“我杀人了。”
第一次杀人，岳雨心里有些忐忑不安，毕竟出生在法治国家的他，杀人可是犯法的。但这里是强者为尊的大陆，弱肉强食，随时都会有人死亡。想着自己杀死的是恶人，也算是为民除害，心情也有了些好转。
岳雨知道，他以后杀的人或许还会很多，这里不再是中国，而是充满杀戮的世界。
看着经验栏增长了一大半，岳雨不由感叹道：“再三百经验就七级了，这速度，史上第一啊。”
同时技能的熟练度也发生了变化。
雷芒指：熟练度：6/1000
隐身术：熟练度：2/1000
疾风幻影：熟练度：1/1000
岳雨觉得技能的升级应该跟熟练度有关。
————————————————————
星梦楼上空，一道嘹亮的鸣叫声响起，划破长空，一头周身散发着蓝芒的巨大雷雕在上空盘旋飞舞。
“那是开阳宗的接引雷雕？！”
“难道这里有开阳宗的弟子？”
“不愧是五大宗门之一的开阳宗，就是这接引雷雕就有着如此强大的气势，怕是已经达到虚无境九阶巅峰了吧。”
街道上人们纷纷抬头仰望，低声议论着。
开阳宗，五大宗门之一，势力强大，可谓是天灵界一方霸主。凡是能成为开阳宗的弟子，资质和身份都不一般，就算是开阳宗的外门弟子，也是受人敬仰。而开阳宗宗主，实力更是达到了破空境九阶巅峰，随时都可以引动天劫，踏入仙道之境。

楚莹听见雕鸣后，便走出了店外。此时，刚好遇见了回来的岳雨，便开口说道：“跟我回开阳宗。”
“上面的大雕是你召来的？”看着大雕，岳雨不由想起了神雕侠侣里面杨过身旁的大雕，两者极其相似。
楚莹轻嗯了一声，意念一动，巨大的雷雕便缓缓落地。
周围的人连忙向后退去，让出一大块空地。
巨雕落地，巨大的身躯足有五米之高。楚莹轻轻一跃，便落在了雷雕的背上。身姿潇洒无比，引得周围人们纷纷赞叹。
而咱们的岳雨同学，则是顺着雷雕放下来的翅膀，抓着那柔软的羽毛，费力的向上爬着，身姿难看无比，引得周围的人纷纷咋舌。
看着岳雨吃力攀爬的样子，楚莹忍俊不禁，有些想笑，她搞不明白岳雨为何要隐藏实力，但岳雨不开口，她也不去会询问，便装作不知道。
呼，岳雨费了半天的力气终于爬到了雷雕的背上，重重的喘了口气，站立在了雷雕的背上。楚莹则是站立在他的前方。
雷雕一声长鸣，展开巨大的双翼，在人们的瞩目之下，腾空而起，如流星一般划破长空，向东方飞去，消失在遥远的天际。
岳雨坐在雷雕的背上，有些惊异，头顶上方有一层蓝色的光罩，耳边呼呼的气流一点也吹进来。并且背上很稳当，即使速度再快，身体也不会颠簸。起初还有些担心一不小心掉下去，此刻岳雨便放心了。
“楚姑娘，多长时间能到啊？”岳雨开口问道。
“还有上万里的距离，两个小时应该就到了。”楚莹略微一算，说道。
“两个小时啊，这么长时间，要不咱俩聊聊人生？”岳雨猥琐的一笑，看着楚莹，一阵鸡动。
“人生？人生靠自己把握，我要修炼了。”楚莹自然听不懂岳雨话里的含义，说完便盘膝而坐，开始修炼。
“呃，异界人民思想就是单纯，值得学习。”岳雨心中暗道。闲着无聊，右手便拖着腮帮，欣赏者大地上的一道道美丽的风景。
两个小时后，岳雨站立在雷雕的背上，望着远方，一座巨大的山脉浮现在眼前。同时，楚莹也是站起了身，望着山脉，神态恬静。
山脉之间云雾缭绕，白鹤齐飞。一座座气势恢宏的宫殿屹立于山峰之上，散发着一股古朴庄重的气息。奇异的花草，遍布每个山峰，花香四溢。
天地之间灵气缭绕，犹如仙境一般。
看着眼前的一切，岳雨眼中露出了震惊之色，“这简直就是人间仙境啊，太美了。”岳雨心中暗赞道。
“跟在我身后。”落地后，楚莹叮嘱道。

“楚姑娘，你们开阳宗也太美太大了吧。”跟在楚莹的身后，岳雨一阵感叹。
“身为五大宗门之一，美丽壮观也是自然的。”
“现在的这座山峰名为紫阳峰，是开阳宗七大主峰之一，由我师傅紫阳真人镇守，其余的六大主峰也是由六大长老镇守，我现在带你去紫阳宫，先安排你住下，然后再给你详说。”楚莹说道。
“好的。”看着楚莹，岳雨很是感激。
不久，两人便来到了一座宫殿之前。宫殿犹如金子雕砌一般，在日光的照耀下，金芒璀璨。宫殿的大门之上挂着一块巨匾，上面刻着“紫阳宫”三个苍劲有力的大字。
进了宫殿之内，守殿的侍者便走了过来，看着楚莹，恭敬的说道：“楚师姐，师尊算到你今日回来，让你待会去见他。”
“嗯，知道了。”楚莹应道。见侍者用疑惑不解的目光看着岳雨，随即便说道：“他是我的朋友，岳雨。你去给他安排下住处，我现在去见师父。”
“嗯，好的。”见眼前的少年是楚莹的朋友，侍者便不敢怠慢。
看着眼前这个身穿青衣长袍，风度翩翩的年轻男侍者，岳雨心中暗叹：“有气质，有修养，一副上位者的样子啊。”
一些开阳宗弟子身份都很特殊，有王宗贵族，有富豪子弟，所以不少人都有着一股上位者的气息。
待楚莹走后，侍者面容和善，丝毫没有因为岳雨是普通人，而感到不屑与鄙夷。“原来是楚师姐的朋友，我叫方敬，兄弟。请跟我来。”说完，便带着岳雨向殿内的一侧走去。
岳雨微微一笑，觉得眼前这人还不错，神态和善。没有一丝倨傲之意。
“方兄，这周围怎么没看到其他的弟子？”岳雨疑惑的问道，一路走来，山峰上一个人影也没有，便有些不解。
“哦，我派飞云峰长老在飞云峰上讲道，除过一些守山弟子和侍者外，所有弟子都去听讲了。”方敬微微一笑道，同时心中不免有些遗憾，长老每三年讲道一次，讲述修炼心得与感悟，对每名弟子都有着启迪作用，使众多弟子在修炼上少走弯路。资质聪慧的人，更是能够瞬间参破奥义，得到突破，基本上大多数人修为都会有所精进。
“哦。这样啊。”听着方敬的讲述，岳雨微微有些好奇。
几分钟后，岳雨和方敬来到了一个巨大的别院之中。别院内花草遍布，散发着一阵清香，岳雨顿时觉得神清气爽，精神奕奕。
远处一座座古朴典雅的房屋整齐的罗列着，碎石小道蜿蜒崎岖，桃花无风自动，翩翩飞舞，异常美丽，犹如世外桃源一般。

Chapter 008 Talk about life
The sixth level of Liwu Realm versus the eighth level of Liwu Realm, a complete victory!
After surpassing two levels of challenges, Yue Yu killed the big man without taking any damage, but if the big man could hold on for a little longer, he might have to run for his life. Because at this time, his spiritual energy has almost returned to zero. If you don't have enough aura and can't use Thunder Finger, you're still in trouble.
"Only four hundred experience?" Compared with the experience gained from killing the spirit-loving beast last time, Yue Yu couldn't help but feel that it was a little less. Considering that he had killed a third-level spirit beast in the Void Realm, and the big man was only in the eighth level of the Martial Arts Realm, he felt that four hundred experience was already pretty good.
Looking at the body of the big man on the ground, Yue Yu sighed secretly, "I killed someone."
The first time he killed someone, Yue Yu felt a little uneasy. After all, he was born in a country ruled by law, and killing someone was illegal. But this is a continent where the strong are respected, the weak eat the strong, and someone will die at any time. Thinking that what he killed was a bad person and he was doing harm to the people, his mood improved a little.
Yue Yu knew that he might kill many more people in the future. This was no longer China, but a world full of killing.
Seeing that the experience bar had increased by more than half, Yue Yu couldn't help but sigh: "With another 300 experience points, I will reach level seven. This speed is the fastest in history."
At the same time, skill proficiency has also changed.
Lightning Finger: Proficiency: 6/1000
Invisibility: Proficiency: 2/1000
Gale Phantom: Proficiency: 1/1000
Yue Yu feels that skill upgrading should be related to proficiency.
——————————————————————
In the sky above Xingmeng Tower, a loud roar sounded, piercing the sky, and a huge thunder eagle with blue light all over its body circled and danced in the sky.
"Is that the Kaiyang Sect's Thunder Eagle?!"
"Are there any disciples of Kaiyang Sect here?"
"As expected of the Kaiyang Sect, one of the five major sects, this Lightning Eagle has such a powerful aura that it may have reached the peak of the ninth level of the Void Realm."
People on the street looked up and talked in low voices.
Kaiyang Sect, one of the five major sects, is powerful and can be said to be the overlord of the Tianling Realm. Anyone who can become a disciple of Kaiyang Sect has extraordinary qualifications and status. Even the outer disciples of Kaiyang Sect are respected by others. As for the leader of Kaiyang Sect, his strength has reached the peak of the ninth level of Breaking the Sky Realm, and he can trigger the Heavenly Tribulation at any time and step into the Immortal Realm.
After Chu Ying heard the call of the eagle, she walked out of the store. At this time, he happened to meet Yue Yu who had returned and said, "Follow me back to Kaiyang Sect."
"Did you summon the big eagle above?" Looking at the big eagle, Yue Yu couldn't help but think of the big eagle next to Yang Guo in The Legend of the Condor Heroes. The two were very similar.
Chu Ying snorted lightly, and with a thought, the huge thunder eagle slowly landed on the ground.
The people around him quickly moved back to make way for a large space.
The giant eagle landed on the ground, and its huge body was five meters high. Chu Ying jumped lightly and landed on Lei Diao's back. His posture was extremely chic, attracting admiration from people around him.
As for our classmate Yue Yu, he followed the downed wings of the Thunder Eagle, grabbed the soft feathers, and climbed up with great effort. His posture was so ugly that the people around him were stunned.
Seeing Yue Yu struggling to climb, Chu Ying couldn't help laughing and wanted to laugh. She couldn't understand why Yue Yu wanted to hide his strength, but Yue Yu didn't speak, and she didn't ask, so she pretended not to know.
Huh, Yue Yu spent a long time and finally climbed onto Lei Diao's back. He took a heavy breath and stood on Lei Diao's back. Chu Ying stood in front of him.
The thunder eagle roared loudly, unfolded its huge wings, and under the attention of people, it soared into the sky, pierced the sky like a meteor, flew to the east, and disappeared into the distant sky.
Yue Yu sat on the back of Lei Diao, a little surprised. There was a blue light shield above his head, and the whistling air flow beside his ears.Not a breath comes in. And it is very stable on the back, so no matter how fast the speed is, the body will not be bumpy. At first, she was a little worried about accidentally falling, but now Yue Yu felt relieved.
"Miss Chu, how long will it take to arrive?" Yue Yu asked.
"There are still tens of thousands of miles away, we should be there in two hours." Chu Ying did some calculations and said.
"Two hours, it's such a long time, why don't we talk about life?" Yue Yu smiled obscenely, looked at Chu Ying, and started to tremble.
"Life? You can control your life by yourself. I want to practice." Naturally, Chu Ying didn't understand the meaning of Yue Yu's words. After speaking, she sat cross-legged and began to practice.
"Well, people from other worlds have simple thoughts and are worth learning from." Yue Yu thought to himself. When he was idle and bored, he dragged his cheek with his right hand and admired the beautiful scenery on the earth.
Two hours later, Yue Yu stood on the back of Lei Diao, looking into the distance, and a huge mountain range appeared in front of him. At the same time, Chu Ying also stood up and looked at the mountains with a calm expression.
The mountains are surrounded by clouds and mist, and white cranes are flying together. Magnificent palaces stand on the mountain peaks, exuding a simple and solemn atmosphere. Strange flowers and plants are spread all over every mountain peak, and the fragrance of flowers is overflowing.
The aura between heaven and earth is lingering like a fairyland.
Looking at everything in front of him, Yue Yu's eyes showed a look of shock, "This is simply a fairyland on earth, so beautiful." Yue Yu secretly praised in his heart.
"Follow me." Chu Ying warned after landing.
"Miss Chu, your Kaiyang Sect is too beautiful." Yue Yu sighed as she followed Chu Ying.
"As one of the five major sects, it is natural to be beautiful and spectacular."
"The current mountain peak is called Ziyang Peak. It is one of the seven main peaks of Kaiyang Sect. It is guarded by my master Ziyang Zhenren. The other six main peaks are also guarded by the six elders. I will take you to Ziyang Palace now and arrange for you to stay first, and then I will give you details." Chu Ying said.
"Okay." Looking at Chu Ying, Yue Yu was very grateful.
Soon, the two came to a palace. The palace is like a building made of gold. Under the sunlight, the golden light shines brightly. A huge plaque hangs above the palace gate, with three powerful characters "Ziyang Palace" engraved on it.
After entering the palace, the waiter guarding the palace came over, looked at Chu Ying, and said respectfully: "Senior Sister Chu, Master expects you to come back today, and will ask you to see him later."
"Yeah, I understand." Chu Ying responded. The waiter looked at Yue Yu with puzzled eyes, and then said: "He is my friend, Yue Yu. You go and arrange a place for him. I will go to see the master now."
"Yeah, okay." Seeing that the young man in front of him was Chu Ying's friend, the waiter didn't dare to neglect him.
Looking at the elegant young male waiter in green robes in front of him, Yue Yu sighed inwardly: "He has temperament and cultivation, and looks like a superior."
Some Kaiyang Sect disciples have very special identities, including nobles from the Wang Sect and children of wealthy people, so many of them have the aura of being in a superior position.
After Chu Ying left, the waiter looked kind and showed no disdain or contempt because Yue Yu was an ordinary person. "It turns out that I am a friend of Senior Sister Chu. My name is Fang Jing, brother. Please come with me." After saying that, he led Yue Yu to one side of the hall.
Yue Yu smiled slightly, feeling that the person in front of him was not bad, with a kind demeanor. There is no hint of arrogance.
"Brother Fang, why don't you see other disciples around here?" Yue Yu asked doubtfully. Along the way, there was no one on the mountain peak, so he was a little puzzled.
"Oh, I sent Elder Feiyun Peak to preach at Feiyun Peak. Except for some disciples guarding the mountain and attendants, all the disciples went to listen to the lecture." Fang Jing said with a slight smile, and at the same time he couldn't help but feel a little regretful. The elder preached once every three years, telling about his cultivation experience and insights, which had an enlightening effect on every disciple, and made many disciples continue to practice.Avoid detours in practicing. People who are talented and intelligent can instantly understand the secrets and achieve breakthroughs. Basically, most people will improve their cultivation.
"Oh. That's it." Listening to Fang Jing's story, Yue Yu was slightly curious.
A few minutes later, Yue Yu and Fang Jing arrived at a huge courtyard. The courtyard was full of flowers and plants, emitting a burst of fragrance. Yue Yu suddenly felt refreshed and energetic.
In the distance, simple and elegant houses are neatly lined up. The gravel paths are winding and rugged. The peach blossoms dance automatically and gracefully without wind. They are extremely beautiful, just like a paradise in the world.
